# Orin AI ecosystem — machine-readable release map
# Canonical home: https://orinai.org/

## Orin AI
A unified ecosystem of free AI tools for developers, by Januth Nimnal.
https://orinai.org/ — https://orinai.org/januth-nimnal

## Live products
- Orin Chat — Core chat with English, Sinhala, Tamil, research, files, memory, voice, and media: https://chat.orinai.org/
- Orin Code — Windows workspace, CLI, and VS Code extension with Core device auth and workspace-bound tools: https://code.orinai.org/
- Orin Agent — self-hosted local gateway, tools, browser actions, sessions, approvals, and artifacts: https://agent.orinai.org/
- Orin MCP — scoped hosted and stdio model access: https://mcp.orinai.org/
- Orin Router — four canonical aliases, ordered failover, and authenticated provider-key management API: https://router.orinai.org/

## Preview and gated products
- Orin Console — isolated PTY sessions with replay and expiring ports: https://github.com/januththedev/orin-console
- Orin Automations — local pipeline compiler, exact-hash approvals, safe runner, and Logseq notes: https://github.com/januththedev/orin-automations
- Orin Tools — public and private search are live; public code execution remains disabled until an Orin-controlled sandbox passes review: https://tools.orinai.org/

## Developer
Januth Nimnal — developer and creator of Orin AI.
Profile: https://orinai.org/januth-nimnal
